firm_data.firm_description: Kauff McGuire & Margolis LLP represents businesses ranging from Fortune 500 companies to start-ups, handling all labor, employment, and immigration matters. The firm combines large-firm expertise and quality with boutique firm flexibility and personalized service.
notable_facts: Maintains practices in New York City and Los Angeles

email.subject: AI for Kauff McGuire & Margolis, built for labor practices like yours
email.body:
Hi James,

I noticed Kauff McGuire & Margolis has been handling labor, employment, and immigration matters across the country since 1972, competing with much larger firms while keeping a focused 23-attorney team. That's exactly the constraint we hear about most: BigLaw resources with a lean operation.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing exactly that. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your NYC office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
